```{r}
read_stored_tavg_tif <- function(year, lat, lon) {
  tavg_file <- paste0(folder_processed, "tavg_ann_", year, ".tif")
  tavg_ann <- terra::rast(tavg_file)
  point_value <- terra::extract(tavg_ann, matrix(c(lon, lat), ncol = 2))
  return(point_value)
}

  MAT <- read_stored_tavg_tif(as.numeric(row$year), as.numeric(row$decimalLatitude), as.numeric(row$decimalLongitude))
  row$MAT <- MAT
  
  processed_data <- bind_rows(processed_data, row)

  saveRDS(processed_data, output_file)
  cat("Processed", i, "of", total_rows, "rows.\n")
}
```

# II. drought stress

## 1. prepare drought-related variable from TerraClimate dataset

```{r}
folder.raw <- "~/lab-data/climate/TerraClimate/annual_drought_2024update/"
us_boundary <- sf::read_sf('~/phenology-urban/data/raw/CONUS/boundary/us_boundarydissolve.shp')
us_boundary <- st_set_crs(us_boundary, "EPSG:4326")
color_leaf <- readRDS("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/local_db/color_leaf.rds")

color_leaf_sm <- color_leaf

process_yearly_data <- function(color_leaf_sm, us_boundary, folder.raw, factor) {
  for (year in unique(color_leaf_sm$First_Yes_Year)) {
    file_path <- paste0(folder.raw, "TerraClimate_", factor, "_", year, ".nc")
    file <- terra::rast(file_path)
    usboun_reproj <- sf::st_transform(us_boundary, crs = sf::st_crs(terra::crs(file, proj = TRUE)))
    yearly_data <- terra::project(terra::mask(terra::crop(file, terra::ext(usboun_reproj)), usboun_reproj), terra::crs(us_boundary))
    spring_data_m <- (yearly_data[[3]] + yearly_data[[4]] + yearly_data[[5]]) / 3
    summer_data_m <- (yearly_data[[6]] + yearly_data[[7]] + yearly_data[[8]]) / 3
    fall_data_m <- (yearly_data[[9]] + yearly_data[[10]] + yearly_data[[11]]) / 3
    spring_color <- terra::extract(spring_data_m, color_leaf_sm)
    summer_color <- terra::extract(summer_data_m, color_leaf_sm)
    fall_color <- terra::extract(fall_data_m, color_leaf_sm)
    color_leaf_sm <- cbind(color_leaf_sm, setNames(list(spring_color[,2]), paste0(factor, "_spring_", year)))
    color_leaf_sm <- cbind(color_leaf_sm, setNames(list(summer_color[,2]), paste0(factor, "_summer_", year)))
    color_leaf_sm <- cbind(color_leaf_sm, setNames(list(fall_color[,2]), paste0(factor, "_fall_", year)))
  }
  return(color_leaf_sm)
}

factors <- c("soil", "pet", "aet", "def")
for (factor in factors) {
  color_leaf_sm <- process_yearly_data(color_leaf, us_boundary, folder.raw, "soil")
}

folder.raw_vpd <- "~/lab-data/climate/TerraClimate/annual_2023_upadate/"
color_leaf_sm <- process_yearly_data(color_leaf_sm, us_boundary, folder.raw_vpd, "vpd")


get_value_for_year <- function(data, year, prefix, default_col = NA) {
  year_col <- paste0(prefix, year)
  if (year_col %in% names(data)) {
    return(data[[year_col]])
  } else if (!is.na(default_col)) {
    return(data[[default_col]])
  } else {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
}
```

## 2. find the relationship of day/night temperature and drought indicator in summer for 11-16 npn fall phenology

### 2.1 using CI to compare the temperature indicators
```{r} 
analyze_color_leaf <- readRDS("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/conus/npn/all_drivers/color_leaf_1116.rds") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  filter(Genus == "Quercus")

colors <- c("No ALAN" = "#00B2EE", "ALAN" = "#EE9572")

get_slopeCI <- function(data, temp_col, doy_col) {
  model_group1 <- lm(as.formula(paste(doy_col, "~", temp_col)), data = data, subset = group == "No ALAN")
  model_group2 <- lm(as.formula(paste(doy_col, "~", temp_col)), data = data, subset = group == "ALAN")
  
  confint_group1 <- confint(model_group1, temp_col, level = 0.95)
  confint_group2 <- confint(model_group2, temp_col, level = 0.95)
  
  slope_group1 <- coef(model_group1)[temp_col]
  slope_group2 <- coef(model_group2)[temp_col]

  plot_data <- data.frame(
    group = c("No ALAN", "ALAN"),
    slope = c(slope_group1, slope_group2),
    lower = c(confint_group1[1], confint_group2[1]),
    upper = c(confint_group1[2], confint_group2[2])
  )
  
  plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(y = group, x = slope, color = group)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    xlim(c(-4, 5)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), width = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(slope, 2)), vjust = -1, size = 4) +
    geom_text(aes(x = lower, label = sprintf("%.2f", lower)), vjust = 1.5, hjust = 0.1, size = 3) +
    geom_text(aes(x = upper, label = sprintf("%.2f", upper)), vjust = 1.5, hjust = 0.3, size = 3) +
    labs(title = temp_col,
         x = "Slope",
         y = "Group") +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = NULL) + 
    theme_classic() +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1/5)
  
  return(plot)
}

result1 <- get_slopeCI(analyze_color_leaf, "Tmax_Summer", "First_Yes_DOY")
result2 <- get_slopeCI(analyze_color_leaf, "Tavg_Summer", "First_Yes_DOY")
result3 <- get_slopeCI(analyze_color_leaf, "Tmin_Summer", "First_Yes_DOY")
combine <- plot_grid(result1,result2,result3, ncol = 1)
combine
ggsave("~/phenology-urban/result/npn/12-22/all_species_CI.png", combine, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
```

### 2.2 compare drought
```{r}
compare_drought_factor <- function(data, drought) {
  boxplot_plot <- ggplot(data, aes_string(x = "group", y = drought, fill= "group")) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(x = "Group", y = drought) +
    theme_classic() +
    geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("No ALAN", "ALAN")), test = "t.test",
                map_signif_level = TRUE, textsize = 6, vjust = 0.4) +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 5/3,
          plot.margin = unit(c(3, 0, 3, 0), "cm"),
          legend.position = "none")
    
  return(boxplot_plot)
}
```

### 2.3 Partial Cor - no group

```{r}

# Partial correlation 
analyze_color_leaf <- analyze_color_leaf %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  na.omit()

#function of temperature
plot_partial_cor <- function(temp_col){
  
  analyze_color_leaf <-  analyze_color_leaf %>%
    subset(select= c("First_Yes_DOY", temp_col, "alan", "summer_sm"))
  
  pcor_result <- pcor(analyze_color_leaf)
  partial_correlations <- pcor_result$estimate["First_Yes_DOY", ]
  partial_correlations <- partial_correlations[-1]
  
  p_values <- pcor_result$p.value["First_Yes_DOY", ]
  p_values <- p_values[-1]
  
  plot_data <- data.frame(
    Variable = names(partial_correlations),
    PartialCorrelation = partial_correlations,
    Significance = p_values
  )
  
  plot_data$SignificanceLabel <- ifelse(plot_data$Significance < 0.01, "**", 
                                        ifelse(plot_data$Significance < 0.05, "*", 
                                               ifelse(plot_data$Significance < 0.1, "^", "")))
  
  plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Variable, y = PartialCorrelation)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "lightgray") +
    coord_flip() +  
    geom_text(aes(x = Variable, y = PartialCorrelation / 2, label = round(PartialCorrelation, 2)), vjust = 1, color = "black", size = 4) +  
    geom_text(aes(x = Variable, y = PartialCorrelation / 2, label = SignificanceLabel), vjust = -1, size = 4, color = "red") +
    labs(title = temp_col, x = "", y = "Partial Correlation") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    theme(
    legend.position = "none", 
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),  
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12)
  )+
    theme(aspect.ratio = 3/1)
  
  return(plot)
}

tmin <- plot_partial_cor("Tmin_Summer")
tavg <- plot_partial_cor("Tavg_Summer")
tmax <- plot_partial_cor("Tmax_Summer")

combine <- plot_grid(tmin,tavg, tmax, nrow = 1,  align = 'v')
combine
```

### 2.4 Partial Cor - group

```{r}
#function of temperature
plot_partial_cor_group <- function(temp_col){
  
  analyze_color_leaf <-  analyze_color_leaf %>%
    subset(select= c("First_Yes_DOY", temp_col, "summer_sm", "group"))
  
  groups <- unique(analyze_color_leaf$group)
  colors <- c("No ALAN" = "#00B2EE", "ALAN" = "#EE9572")
  plot_list <- list()
  
  for (grp in groups) {
    group_data <- analyze_color_leaf %>%
      filter(group == grp) %>%
       subset(select= c("First_Yes_DOY", temp_col, "summer_sm"))
    pcor_result <- pcor(group_data)

    partial_correlations <- pcor_result$estimate["First_Yes_DOY", ]
    partial_correlations <- partial_correlations[-1]

    p_values <- pcor_result$p.value["First_Yes_DOY", ]
    p_values <- p_values[-1]
    
    plot_data <- data.frame(
      Variable = names(partial_correlations),
      PartialCorrelation = partial_correlations,
      Significance = p_values
    )

    plot_data$SignificanceLabel <- ifelse(plot_data$Significance < 0.01, "**", 
                                          ifelse(plot_data$Significance < 0.05, "*", 
                                                 ifelse(plot_data$Significance < 0.1, "^", "")))
    plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Variable, y = PartialCorrelation)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = colors[grp]) + 
      coord_flip() +  
      geom_text(aes(x = Variable, y = PartialCorrelation / 2, label = round(PartialCorrelation, 2)), vjust = 1, color = "black", size = 4) +  
      geom_text(aes(x = Variable, y = PartialCorrelation / 2, label = SignificanceLabel), vjust = -1, size = 4, color = "red") +
      labs(title = paste(grp), x = "", y = "Partial Correlation") +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none", 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = if (grp == "No ALAN") element_text(size = 12) else element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = if (grp == "No ALAN") element_text(size = 12) else element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14)
      ) +
      theme(aspect.ratio = 4/1)
    
    plot_list[[grp]] <- plot
  }
  
  overlap_plot <- ggdraw() +
    draw_plot(plot_list[[1]], x = -0.2, y = 0, width = 1, height = 1) +  
    draw_plot(plot_list[[2]], x = 0.25, y = 0, width = 1, height = 1, scale = 1)  

  final_plot <- plot_grid(
    ggdraw() + draw_label(temp_col, size = 16, x = 0.5, y = 0.7, fontface = "bold"),
    overlap_plot,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.05, 1))
  return(final_plot)
}

tmin <- plot_partial_cor_group("Tmin_Summer")
tavg <- plot_partial_cor_group("Tavg_Summer")
tmax <- plot_partial_cor_group("Tmax_Summer")

combine <- plot_grid(tmin,tavg, tmax, nrow = 1,  align = 'v')
combine
ggsave("~/phenology-urban/result/npn/12-22/all_species_par_cor_group.png", combine, width = 14, height = 6, units = "in")
```


## 3. Using model

### 3.0 variable correlation - select for model
```{r}
analyze_color_leaf <- readRDS("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/conus/npn/all_drivers/color_leaf_1116.rds") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  subset(select= c("First_Yes_DOY", "Tavg_Summer", "alan", "summer_sm", "summer_vpd"))

#calculate correlation and significance test
df <- cor(analyze_color_leaf)
p_values <- matrix(NA, ncol = ncol(df), nrow = ncol(df))
for (i in 1:(ncol(df) - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):ncol(df)) {
        result <- cor.test(df[[i]], df[[j]])
        p_values[i, j] <- result$p.value
    }
}
p_values <- ifelse(p_values < 0.05, "*", "")

#calculate partial correlation and significance test
p_correlation <- pcor(analyze_color_leaf)
p_correlation_matrix <- p_correlation$estimate
p_value_matrix <- p_correlation$p.value
p_value_matrix <- ifelse(p_value_matrix < 0.05, "*", "")

library(car)
vif(lm(First_Yes_DOY ~ summer_sm + alan + Tavg_Summer, data = analyze_color_leaf))

analyze_color_leaf2 <- analyze_color_leaf %>%
  mutate(temp_bin = cut(Tavg_Summer, breaks = seq(floor(min(Tavg_Summer)), ceiling(max(Tavg_Summer)), by = 2)))
boxplot <- ggplot(analyze_color_leaf2, aes(x = temp_bin, y = summer_vpd, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Soil Moisture Distribution by Temperature Bins and Group",
       x = "Temperature Bin (2°C)",
       y = "Soil Moisture",
       fill = "Group") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
boxplot + geom_signif(
  comparisons = list(c("Urban", "Rural")),
  map_signif_level = TRUE,
  step_increase = 0.1,
  test = "t.test"
)
```

```{r}
# isSingular

                         (1 | Genus) + (1|First_Yes_Year) + 
                         (0 + Tavg_Summer_scaled | Genus) +

# isSingular

MuMIn::r.squaredGLMM(mod_2)

       y = "Colored leaf (day of year)",

# table 1
sum_lmm_fix = function(x, m){
  broom.mixed::tidy(x, "fixed") %>% 
    mutate(p = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "***", 
                      ifelse(p.value < 0.01, "**", 
                             ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))),
           est = paste0(round(estimate, 3), p),
           model = m) %>% 
    dplyr::select(model, term, est)
}

mod_all_sene_empi = bind_rows(sum_lmm_fix(mod_1, "Temp. only"),
                              sum_lmm_fix(mod_2, "SoilM. only"),
                              sum_lmm_fix(mod_3, "Temp. + SoilM."),
                              sum_lmm_fix(mod_4, "Temp. × SoilM.")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "model", names_from = "term", values_from = est) %>% 
  bind_cols(xaic) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-df) %>% 
  rename(Intercept = "(Intercept)",
         Temp. = Tavg_Summer_scaled, SoilM. = summer_sm_scaled,
         `Temp. : SoilM.` = "Tavg_Summer_scaled:summer_sm_scaled",
         `delta AIC` = delta, `Model weight` = w)
# test
```

```{r}
mod_3_1 = lmerTest::lmer(First_Yes_DOY ~ Tavg_Summer_scaled + alan_scaled + summer_vpd_scaled + 
                         (1 | Genus) + (1|First_Yes_Year) + 
                         (0 + Tavg_Summer_scaled | Genus) +
                         (0 + summer_vpd_scaled | Genus) +
                         (0 + alan_scaled | Genus),
                       data = analyze_color_leaf, control = control)

summary(mod_3_1)

mod_3_2 = lmerTest::lmer(First_Yes_DOY ~ Tavg_Summer_scaled * alan_scaled + summer_vpd_scaled + 
                         (1 | Genus) + (1|First_Yes_Year) + 
                         (0 + Tavg_Summer_scaled | Genus) +
                         (0 + summer_vpd_scaled | Genus) +
                         (0 + alan_scaled | Genus) +
                         (0 + Tavg_Summer_scaled:alan_scaled | Genus),
                       data = analyze_color_leaf, control = control)

summary(mod_3_2)

mod_3_3 = lmerTest::lmer(First_Yes_DOY ~ alan_scaled * summer_vpd_scaled + Tavg_Summer_scaled + 
                         (1 | Genus) + (1|First_Yes_Year) + 
                         (0 + Tavg_Summer_scaled | Genus) +
                         (0 + summer_vpd_scaled | Genus) +
                         (0 + alan_scaled | Genus) +
                         (0 + alan_scaled:summer_vpd_scaled | Genus),
                       data = analyze_color_leaf, control = control)

mod_3_3 = lmerTest::lmer(First_Yes_DOY ~  Tavg_Summer_scaled * summer_vpd_scaled + alan_scaled + 
                         (1 | Genus) + (1|First_Yes_Year) + 
                         (0 + Tavg_Summer_scaled | Genus) +
                         (0 + summer_vpd_scaled | Genus) +
                         (0 + alan_scaled | Genus) +
                         (0 + Tavg_Summer_scaled:summer_vpd_scaled | Genus),
                       data = analyze_color_leaf, control = control)
summary(mod_3_3)

xaic = AIC(mod_1_1, mod_1_2, mod_1_3,mod_2_1, mod_2_2, mod_2_3, mod_3_1, mod_3_2, mod_3_3) %>% as.data.frame()
xaic$delta = xaic$AIC - min(xaic$AIC)

mod_all_sene_empi = bind_rows(sum_lmm_fix(mod_1_1, "Temp. only"),
                              sum_lmm_fix(mod_1_2, "VPD only"),
                              sum_lmm_fix(mod_1_3, "ALAN only"),
                              sum_lmm_fix(mod_2_1, "Temp. × ALAN"),
                              sum_lmm_fix(mod_2_2, "Temp. × VPD"),
                              sum_lmm_fix(mod_2_3, "ALAN × VPD"),
                              sum_lmm_fix(mod_3_1, "Temp. + VPD + ALAN"),
                              sum_lmm_fix(mod_3_2, "Temp. × ALAN + VPD"),
                              sum_lmm_fix(mod_3_3, "ALAN × VPD + Temp.")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "model", names_from = "term", values_from = est) %>% 
  bind_cols(xaic) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-df) %>% 
  rename(Intercept = "(Intercept)",
         Temp. = Tavg_Summer_scaled, VPD = summer_vpd_scaled, ALAN = alan_scaled, 
         `Temp. : VPD` = "Tavg_Summer_scaled:summer_vpd_scaled",
         `Temp. : ALAN` = "Tavg_Summer_scaled:alan_scaled",
         `VPD : ALAN` = "alan_scaled:summer_vpd_scaled",
         `delta AIC` = delta)
```

### 3.5 SEM model

```{r}
library(lavaan)
analyze_color_leaf <- readRDS("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/conus/npn/all_drivers/color_leaf_1116.rds") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  mutate(inter_alan_sm = alan * summer_sm_scaled) %>%
  mutate(inter_alan_temp = alan * Tavg_Summer_scaled)

m1 <-   '
  # regressions
    First_Yes_DOY ~ 1 + Tavg_Summer_scaled + summer_sm_scaled + alan + inter_alan_sm + inter_alan_temp
    summer_sm_scaled ~ 1 + alan 
    Tavg_Summer_scaled ~ 1 + alan
  # covariance and variance
    Tavg_Summer_scaled ~~ Tavg_Summer_scaled
    summer_sm_scaled ~~ summer_sm_scaled
    alan ~~ alan
    First_Yes_DOY ~~ First_Yes_DOY
'
fit1 <- sem(m1, data = analyze_color_leaf)
summary(fit1, fit.measures=TRUE)
```
